The `makepkg --printsrcinfo` command only sources the PKGBUILD file's global scope. The source URLs point to the legitimate GitHub releases page for the justray project, and the checksums are properly defined. There are no command substitutions, network requests, eval calls, or other executable code in the global scope that could pose a threat during this command.
</details>
<evidence></evidence>
